lessons.title: Coordinates, axes and units: where is (3, 2)?
lessons.summary: Why screen y points down while world y often points up, and how to convert between pixels and world units with two small functions.

lessons.title: Vectors: a place or a movement?
lessons.summary: How one pair of numbers can mean a place or a movement, how to tell them apart, and how end minus start gives the move between two points.

lessons.title: Adding and subtracting vectors: paddling across a river
lessons.summary: How adding vectors tip to tail combines two movements, and how subtracting them tells you what to add to get the movement you want.
